title: Ketu, Karma and Blessings
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 29 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Ketu as body and cloud, the karma account, curses and blessings, Ganesha, Ketu in houses 1 to 12 and Q&A.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 29, Planet Ketu by Brajesh Gautam: karma account, the cloud, the water centre, Ganesha, Ketu by house, Q&A, with video timestamps.
points: It has hands and feet but no head. It acts as the head fitted on it: Jupiter, Venus, Neptune and so on.
Curses and blessings pile up. Ketu delivers the fruit. Earn blessings and stop cursing yourself and others.
A person who has hundreds praying for him needs no begging. Serve people.
It is a cloud that enlarges what it touches. The west-south-west of the home is its zone.
In each house, giving in that area brings money back. Do not boast.
Enjoy and let go. Ego must be left with God or a guru.
Fertility, birth defects, gold plating and other health claims are his own and not endorsed.
